content.short: Wallet is Telegram's built-in crypto wallet for buying, trading, and transferring crypto inside Telegram.
content.description: Wallet is a crypto wallet built directly into Telegram. Its site describes buying, trading, and transferring USDT, Bitcoin, TON, and other crypto assets, along with payments, gifts, balances, and tokenized asset features. It is one of the most direct wallet experiences for Telegram users interacting with TON. Buy, trade, and transfer crypto directly in Telegram, with a wallet built for everyday life. Those details make earn interest on your balance and tokenized payouts on your stocks, protect your assets with a secure passcode, and no downloads, no seed phrases part of the product story. just tap and go.
